title: refactor(ui): tool drawing inks are theme tokens
body:
The four PRs under this one (#3990, #3992, #3993, #4072) are merged. The branch merges `main` at 498382c8e (5b9256022). The change is 5d2c2b2d6. The review fix is 25b220b34.

## What changed

The fourth family of #1120: the tool drawing inks.

- Eighteen colour tokens join `Tokens`. Each is also a theme-file key (`colors.<name>`):
  - the tool, holder and profile previews: `tool_ground`, `tool_axis`, `tool_grid`, `tool_flute`, `tool_shank`, `tool_body`, `tool_edge`, `tool_holder`, `tool_note`, `tool_dim`;
  - the library thumbnails: `thumb_flute` (their shank reads `tool_shank`);
  - the refusal and warning inks of the tool pages: `bad_ink`, `warn_ink`;
  - the tool body page: `mount_axis`, `mount_radial`, `mount_tip`, `mount_origin`, `mount_hint`.
- Both tables hold the old values, so no pixel changes. The previews keep their own dark ground in the light theme, as before.
- The module colour consts (`NOTE`, `BAD`, `HOLDER`, `BG`, `BODY`, `EDGE`, `DIM`, `WARN`, `CUT`, `SHANK`) become functions with the same visibility (`note_ink()`, `bad_ink()`, `holder_ink()`, `tool_ground()`, ...). Each reads the live token. The callers change by name only. One colour role is one key: the note grey was a const in five files, the axis line in three.
- `theme::with_alpha(colour, alpha)`: a token's own colour at an alpha, read unmultiplied, so a partly transparent token does not darken twice (the defect of the #3993 review). The holder fills (alpha 90 in the profile, 70 in the preview) use it. `ground_ink::facet_veil` now calls it too.
- Draw sites: `tool_profile_page.rs`, `tool_preview.rs`, `tool_model_view.rs`, `tool_body_page.rs`, `tool_body_lathe_page.rs`, `tool_holder_picker.rs`, `tool_cutter_page.rs`, `tool_cutter_params.rs`, and `tool_library_dialog/` (`holder_view.rs`, `side_view.rs`, `thumbs.rs`, `assembly_group.rs`, `preview.rs`).
- The colour-literal guard loses the ten rows of the tool family. `theme/tables.rs` goes from 82 to 118.
- The example theme and the colour table of the user guide have the eighteen keys.
- Decision record: `docs/decisions/1120-tool-inks.md`.

## Review fix (25b220b34)

The tool list thumbnails (`thumbs.rs`) and the holder outline (`holder_view.rs`) keep their built shapes, and the shapes carry theme colours. Before the fix, each cache key held only the tool or holder inputs, so a theme change kept the old colours.

- Each cache key now also holds the inks that its shapes carry:
  - thumbnails: `thumb_flute` and `tool_shank`;
  - holder outline: `tool_axis`, `tool_body`, `tool_edge` and `tool_dim`.
- The holder ground and the labels are painted live each frame, so they are not in the key.
- `build` takes the inks from the key, so the key and the shapes cannot disagree.
- The cache lookup of the holder view moves into `drawing()`, so a unit test can call it without a window.

## Pinning tests

In `crates/ui/tests/theme_files/tool_inks.rs`, a new module of the existing `theme_files` test binary (#3187: no new binary):

- `the_built_in_columns_keep_the_tool_drawing_colours`: both tables carry the old literals.
- `each_tool_drawing_ink_is_a_theme_key`: each key sets its own ink.
- `a_holder_fill_keeps_the_colour_of_its_token`: the built-in holder gives the old fills at alpha 90 and 70, and a `#FF000080` token gives `[255, 0, 0]` at alpha 70, not a darker red.

The review fix, as unit tests of the `camcraft-ui` lib (no new binary):

- `tool_library_dialog::thumbs::tests::a_theme_change_of_the_inks_builds_the_row_drawing_again`
- `tool_library_dialog::holder_view::tests::a_theme_change_of_the_inks_builds_the_holder_outline_again`

Each test draws, checks that the same inks build nothing, changes the inks, checks one new build with the new colours and no old colour, and checks that the next drawing holds. With the inks removed from the cache comparison, both tests are red. The still-frame tests `a_document_row_has_a_cached_drawing_and_its_gauge_length` and `a_still_frame_builds_no_holder_outline` stay green.

Also: `theme_example::example_loads_and_holds_the_dark_defaults`, `theme_files::viewport_inks::the_facet_veil_keeps_the_hover_colour_of_a_semi_transparent_token` (now through `with_alpha`) and `theme_files::colour_literals::no_colour_literal_outside_the_allowed_rows`.

## Screenshots

The tool library window, a tool open in the library editor (the tool preview), and the tool shape window on its Profile, Body and Holder library tabs, in the dark and light theme. The images come from the off-screen renderer (`egui_kittest` with the headless wgpu device, as in `guide_images`), at 1280 x 720. The images are on the images-only `pr-screenshots` branch of the fork, not on this branch.

A pixel comparison of each pair gives 0 different pixels. The images come from 5d2c2b2d6 and its parent, before the merge of main, so that the pair shows this change only.

The images do not show a lathe tool on the Body tab (the radial arrow) or a refused cutter (the red outline and text). The tests pin those values.

## Gates

On the head 25b220b34:

- Quick gate (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`): 10 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (4.6 min).
- `cargo clippy --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-ui -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Heavy lanes: the diff reaches none.

## Merge of main

The merge of 498382c8e (5b9256022) had no conflict.

Earlier merge: 
Main had changed `tool_library_dialog/preview.rs` (#3908, helical flutes): `model_3d` now takes the mesh and the bounds as parameters. The merge keeps main's function and the `tool_ground()` call of this branch. No other file conflicted, and main added no colour literal in the files of this family.

## Not exercised

- No check by hand in the GUI. The tests and the pixel comparison pin the values.

Changelog: Themes can set the colours of the tool, holder and profile previews, the tool library thumbnails, the tool body page, and the refusal and warning text of the tool pages.

Refs #1120
